name: Marginals
description: The Marginals were a New York street gang active on the Lower West Side during the early 1900s, based between Ninth and Tenth Avenues and competing for control of the Hudson River docks. Operating under stevedore Thomas F. 'Tanner' Smith, the gang battled the Hudson Dusters for control of the territory, eventually succeeding them. They were involved in extortion and labor slugging. Their reign ended when Smith was murdered on July 26, 1919.
